name: Sonnette™ Cellular Roller Shades
description: Sonnette™ Cellular Roller Shades combine the clean look of a roller shade with the energy efficiency of a cellular shade in a curved modern design.

benefits.text:
The Whole House Solution™
Many Sonnette fabrics coordinate with Duette® Honeycomb Shades, 
so you can cover every window in your home.
Certified for Energy Efficiency
Sonnette shades are rated by the Attachments Energy Rating Council (AERC) 
in the roller shade category for providing enhanced energy savings.
Stylish Fabric Choices
Sonnette shades are available in a wide fabric selection, in colors ranging from 
whites and neutrals to vibrant hues, to complement a variety of design tastes.
Dimensional Beauty
The soft curves of Sonnette® shades add visual interest and offer subtle 
movement in the window.
Light Diffusion
Sonnette fabrics capture natural light and diffuse it throughout the room 
to produce a soft, warm glow.
Versatility
The clean, simple design of Sonnette® shades allows you to customize 
them to fit your specific needs and style.
Benefits
Increased Privacy
When fully lowered, Sonnette shades with Kickback™ retract 
toward the window for added privacy.
Responsibly Designed
Sonnette shades are GREENGUARD certified for low indoor chemical emissions.

Energy Efficiency
Cost Savings
Shades help control the indoor temperature, so you can spend less to 
heat and cool your home. 
Superior Insulation
A proprietary insulating design features an extra layer that protects your home 
from harsh outdoor temperatures.
Automation Throughout the Year 
PowerView® Automation lets you schedule shades to open and close according to 
the sun’s movements, so your home’s temperature is regulated automatically.
Sustainability
Shades may eliminate a need for artificial lighting by softly diffusing 
natural sunlight within a room.

10:30 PM Bedtime
Shades close automatically for privacy and a perfect night’s sleep.
7:00 AM Morning

Based on your local sunset time, shades open to reveal your best view.
2:00 PM Afternoon

OPERATING SYSTEMS
AND DESIGN OPTIONS

Textured Matte Finish Headrail 
Standard metal headrail offers a sleek, minimalist look.
Front Roll with Kickback™ 
Sonnette® shades with Kickback retract into the window for enhanced privacy 
and a minimized light gap when fully lowered. Standard on SoftTouch® Motorization, 
PowerView® Automation and Custom Clutch. Not available on LiteRise®.
Front Roll Only 
Sonnette shades are available in a front roll only design without Kickback. Fabric 
will hang flush with the front of the headrail. Standard on LiteRise. Optional on 
SoftTouch Motorization, PowerView Automation and Custom Clutch.
Fabric-Covered Headrail 
Upgrade to a color-coordinated fabric-wrapped headrail to create a finished look.
